object.attr: derived: removing a suspect link and adding it again in two operations records the target's last change and turns the link OK with nothing reviewed, while the committed link still holds the review (CF-T39). Answered on 2026-11-10.
object.description: When Mellon creates a link that replaces no link in the same operation, and the latest commit holds a link between the same objects, Mellon shall give the new link that link's acknowledged commit.
